status: written before any v8 run was trained

runs.environment: one GPU type and software stack for every v8 run (v8_env.json)

graph_ablations.agcn_static: A + B (learned static graph), data-dependent term alpha * C(x) removed
graph_ablations.agcn_fixedgraph: A only: graph parameters frozen at initialisation (B = 0, alpha = 0)
questions: Q1: is the 2s-AGCN minus ST-GCN excess-ECE difference at >= 10,000 clips produced by graph adaptivity (2s-AGCN minus agcn_fixedgraph)?
Q2: by the data-dependent term (2s-AGCN minus agcn_static)?
Q3: by the learned static graph (agcn_static minus agcn_fixedgraph)?
Q4: by the layer without adaptivity (agcn_fixedgraph minus ST-GCN)?

backbone_comparison: the three pairwise differences with six seeds in one environment; also six seeds with one environment per seed (seeds 0-2 original, 3-4 G4 replication, 5 v8)
environment_effect: seeds 0-4: earlier run vs v8 run of the same backbone, rung and seed, against the standard deviation across seeds
statistic: per seed: difference in excess adaptive ECE (15 equal-mass bins, matched null floor) averaged over the three rungs; also NLL, Brier score, adaptive ECE, top-1
tests: exact sign-flip test over seeds, two-sided
t-interval of the mean per-seed difference
